issue.description:
ADR-003's measured defect 3 is that most mutations do not advance the live event sequence, and AGENTS.md requires every mutating operation to be auditable. Open beads cover four families (create_issue, dependencies, external references, structured data), but no bead accounts for the remaining mutating surfaces — label add/remove, resource-key add/remove, notes/assignee updates, and manifest — leaving the invariant unproven. Enumerate every public mutating service API, emit audit events for any family still silent, and add a test asserting each mutation path advances the event sequence and publishes it in the checkpoint.
